evals.name: explicit-higgsfield-motion-ask
evals.prompt: I just saw the Higgsfield motion design demo on X — the samurai one with the Claude Code + Higgsfield MCP pipeline. Make me one but for 'the discipline of a craftsman', 9:16 for IG, with the 6 lines you think work best. Save everything to ~/.claude/outputs and tell me when the final mp4 is ready.
evals.expected_output: Skill creates ~/.claude/outputs/motion-design/discipline-of-a-craftsman-<ts>/ with references/, storyboard/scene_1..6.png, video/final.mp4 (or final_url.txt), lines.txt with 6 lines, and MANIFEST.md. Final delivery is one line + path, no JSON dump.

evals.name: vague-motion-ad-ask
evals.prompt: build me a scroll-stop motion ad about saving money for my IG. arabic version too if u can.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, picks the money-mindset theme pack from themes-library.md, runs the full pipeline once in English (9:16) and once in Arabic with RTL prompts. Delivers two final mp4s with clear labels.

evals.name: user-supplies-own-lines
evals.prompt: Motion design video for my fitness brand. 6 scenes. The lines must be exactly: 'PAIN IS DATA' / 'ONE MORE REP' / 'NO REST DAYS FROM SHOWING UP' / 'THE BODY OBEYS THE MIND' / 'BECOME UNRECOGNIZABLE' / 'SHOW UP'. Theme: monastic gym aesthetic. Aspect 9:16.
evals.expected_output: Skill uses the user's 6 lines verbatim (does NOT invent new ones), generates the storyboard with the monastic gym style anchors, animates with Seedance, returns final mp4 path. lines.txt matches the user's text exactly.

evals.name: near-miss-should-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Animate this single PNG of my product into a 5-second image-to-video clip with a slow push-in. Just one shot, no storyboard nonsense.
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT trigger. The task is a single-clip image-to-video, which belongs to higgsfield-generate. Motion-design pipeline would be overkill and the user explicitly said 'no storyboard'.
